newsitem.title: UK: BOC sees new gas sales of 20-200 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: BOC sees new gas sales of 20-200 mln stg.

text.p: British industrial gases group BOC Plc said on Thursday sales of its new synthetic liquefied air could total between 20 million and 200 million stg a year.
"Sales could be north of 20 million stg to south of 200 million stg a year," Deb Chatterji, BOC managing director of technology, told a news conference at the launch.
Chatterji said BOC was examining potential uses for the gas, which can create breathable chilled spaces. BOC said it was focusing on applications for the food and aerospace industries.
BOC said earlier on Thursday it was the first company to launch liquified synthetic air commercially.

BOC shares were up 5-1/2p at 940-1/2p at 1213 GMT. The company said earlier today that sales in Britain could total around 10 million stg a year. It said it was in talks with a number of potential users, including supermarkets.
